summary: Backend: 21/21 pytest passed (categories shape; visitor create validation for factory/staff/management; staff Others free-text path; employee JWT login + /me + /visitors filtered by dept; PATCH status via Bearer for assignee + 409 lock when admin pre-decides; 403 cross-dept; admin PIN regression; qr-entry returns 200 PNG with X-Entry-Url). Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): cascading dropdowns verified — Factory Visit shows ONLY Operation/QA/QC, Staff Visit shows all 9 including Others, Others reveals custom-person-input, single-employee Operation auto-fills Nishit Patel. Employee login flow: nishit.patel@maxwell.com/maxwell@123 redirects to dashboard, all 4 filter chips render, dept-filtered list shows pending Operation requests (TEST_OP_PEND, TEST_OP_V). Wrong password keeps user on login screen with alert. Logout button works (navigation observed in DOM though one selector race-condition during regression — see minor below).

react_native_issues.issue: RN-web deprecation warnings still present (shadow*, props.pointerEvents, resizeMode). Non-blocking.

Two DOM elements share data-testid="visitor-form-title" (RN renders title twice — likely the header + a Text). Causes Playwright wait_for_selector races. Consider giving the header a distinct testID or only setting it on the main Text component.

action_items: Optional: rename one of the duplicate visitor-form-title testIDs to avoid duplicate-element selector flakiness in automation.
critical_code_review_comments: JWT decode + employee lookup in PATCH /visitors/{id}/status duplicates the logic in get_current_employee dependency — could be refactored to a shared helper or Depends(get_current_employee_optional).
Seeded employees use bcrypt rounds=10 with default password 'maxwell@123' from .env — fine for dev; ensure rotation in production.
_id projection consistently excluded across all queries (find_one_and_update uses projection={_id:0}).
qr-entry requires PUBLIC_APP_URL — properly returns 500 if missing; no hardcoded fallback. .env has it set.
Cascading dropdown logic correctly enforced both client-side (DEPARTMENTS_FACTORY filter) and server-side (validation rejects HR for factory_visit).

Employee can decide if assigned_to matches OR same department — note: this is intentional per spec but means any Operation employee could decide for any other Operation visitor; OK because Operation only has one employee. For multi-employee depts (HR/Marketing) this is by-design first-responder-wins.
seed_data_creation: TEST_-prefixed visitors created during pytest (TEST_FactoryGuy, TEST_Y2, TEST_Z, TEST_M, TEST_HR_V, TEST_OP_V, TEST_OP_PEND x3, TEST_LOOKUP). Mobiles 9000000001-9000000099. Not cleaned up (per existing convention).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://guest-pass-simple.preview.emergentagent.com pytest /app/backend/tests/test_visitors_v2.py -v. Employee creds in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. To trigger 409 lock in frontend, admin approves via PIN 1234 then employee taps approve — Alert 'Already decided' will appear. Two duplicate visitor-form-title testIDs in index.tsx may cause selector races for next agent.
rca_of_issue: N/A — all new features functional. Only minor improvement is testID uniqueness.
